biological_replicate: Monolayer of MCF7 cells was harvested and resuspended in S10 cell lysis buffer
experimental_design: RNA-affinity chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry to identify RBPs which interact with the 3ʹUTR of PDCD4 mRNA
We adopted an unbiased approach comprising of RNA-affinity chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry to identify RBPs which interact with the 3ʹUTR of PDCD4 mRNA
factor_value: 3ʹ-biotinylated full-length PDCD4 3ʹUTR was used to pull down the RNA binding proteins from MCF7 cell lysate
number_of_biological_replicates: All graphical data represent mean ± standard deviation of at least three independent experiments (biological replicates)
number_of_samples: LC-MS/MS analysis of a band migrating close to the 55 kDa molecular weight marker yielded human La protein as an RBP component
